Personality: Liachin is a cold and deeply calculating Battanian lady. Unlike traditional warriors who revere personal martial valor, she prefers to consolidate power through precise calculation and control of resources. Devoid of sympathy, she takes a hard line when managing fief affairs or confronting political rivals, earning a reputation for ruthless severity. She pursues craft, trade, and engineering with near-obsessive dedication, believing that stout walls and a full treasury safeguard a clan's survival far better than hollow honor. In social settings, though she possesses a measure of charm, she deploys it out of calculated interest rather than genuine warmth. A pragmatic administrator who keeps a cool head at all times, she weighs pros and cons with exacting precision amid Battania's turbulent politics to defend her interests in the most rational manner possible.
Background: Liachin belongs to the prominent Battanian house of fen Giall and resides at the clan seat of Pen Cannoc. As the wife of the clan leader Aeron, she works alongside a husband widely regarded as mad and dangerous to sustain their family's eminent standing within the kingdom. Although Battania's chieftains are naturally rebellious and harbor misgivings toward the High King's authority, Liachin maintains political fealty to Caladog, using her outstanding administrative talents to provide logistical and engineering support to the realm. Not only does she oversee the economic operations of the clan's fiefs, she also personally supervises weapon smithing and fortification works. While raising her son Gavan, she manages the enterprises of Clan fen Giall with an iron hand, ensuring that between the High King and the scheming chieftains her house remains an indispensable pillar of power as the true mastermind behind Pen Cannoc.
